correctness.rationale: The finite domain consists of all 2^18-1 nonempty arc masks. An exact enumerator selects 714 faces, verifies all 2376 cover relations, 341 pairs, a full 714-node acyclic topological sort, and critical counts (1 in dim 0, 19 in dim 3, 12 in dim 4). The exact signed Morse ∂4 has no nonzero entries. Because the 3-skeleton is a wedge of 19 three-spheres and 2-connected, Hurewicz makes each zero-boundary four-cell attachment nullhomotopic. Hence the claimed integral wedge. A second exact rational calculation gives rank ∂4=60 and the 72-element full automorphism character, constant on all nine conjugacy classes; independent mod-two boundary ranks corroborate Betti numbers.

value.rationale: The graph is the smallest balanced three-regular complete bipartite graph, the first thick symmetric case beyond a part of size two. Its unexpected adjacent-degree 19+12 wedge splitting is a meaningful exact natural homotopy invariant, and the full nine-class rational symmetry character distinguishes the invariant subspaces (dimensions one and zero), information invisible from Betti ranks. This supplies a concrete structural benchmark for general bidirected multipath complexes rather than an arbitrary slice or a minor numerical improvement.
